mapper.select: SELECT record_id, student_id, student_name, schedule_id, course_name, record_type, reason, status, created_at FROM leave_make_up WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY record_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_make_up(record_id, student_id, student_name, schedule_id, course_name, record_type, reason, status) VALUES(#{recordId}, #{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{scheduleId}, #{courseName}, #{recordType}, #{reason}, #{status})
